Definition: neuter of a derivative of G4967; a victim (in sacrifice):--slain beast.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the slain beast itself, the victim on the altar. Stephen asks Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness? The answer, in God's charge, is that their worship went to the host of heaven instead.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the slain beast asks the hard question: the offering is only worship when the heart offers it to the Lord.
